Critical item; full proof read. Shared-pole case: the product and point-to-segment estimates place h^j near some x_{i(j)} with i(j)->infinity, the finite-ball pigeonhole gives equal elements and hence equal positive powers, so the pole pairs agree. Existence: otherwise every conjugate pole pair equals {g+,g-}, the stabiliser is G, contradicting the finite-index bound and non-virtual-cyclicity. Exponents and inversions checked.
Read the full proof: four distinct poles, six finite Hausdorff separations, finite intersections O_i, and pairwise disjointness. Finite existential instantiation, no AC; no existence claim.
